headline: Sensex Ends Flat While Nifty Gains; Smallcaps and Metals Shine
why: Moody's raised India's FY27 growth forecast to 7 percent
Metals and FMCG sectors saw buying interest ahead of Fed call
Smallcap stocks jumped nearly 1.8 percent outperforming large caps
Oil price retreat eased global inflation fears boosting sentiment
whatHappening: India's foreign exchange reserves dropped by $4.9 billion recently
STT collections surged 53 percent following the recent rate hike
Hi-Tech Flow Solutions filed for a 300 crore rupee IPO
Indian bonds recorded a fifth consecutive weekly loss

summary: The Indian market showed mixed performance as Nifty gained while Sensex ended slightly lower amid IT sector weakness. Positive sentiment in metals, FMCG, and smallcaps offset concerns over falling forex reserves and bond losses. Investors remain focused on global cues including the upcoming Fed decision and easing oil prices.
